sentences.text: Tapan Kumar Roy @ Ray vs Unknown on 12 June, 2024

Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen
12.06.2024
 Sl No.369
Court No.29
 Tn
 (Allowed)
 Crm (A) 1891 of 2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under section 438 of
 the Code of Criminal Procedure filed in connection with Kalyani
 Police Station Case No.636 of 2023 dated 26.09.2023 under
Sections 409/420 of the Indian Penal Code.

And 
 In the matter of : Tapan Kumar Roy @ Ray.
 - petitioner.
 Mr. Shibaji Kumar Das
 ....for the petitioner.

1. 
The learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated.

However, the petitioner admits that he has refunded a sum of Rs. 7,44,507/- which was alleged to have been misappropriated by him with the postal authorities.
2.

The learned APP on behalf of the State in opposing the prayer has referred to the case diary and submits that the entire amount has been received by the postal department and a departmental proceeding was initiated against the petitioner that had resulted in his dismissal.
3. It is, however, submitted that the charge sheet has already been filed.

4. Considering the materials available in the case diary and having regard to the fact that the entire amount has been refunded to the postal department in the meantime and charge sheet has already been filed, we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not necessary.

5. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner, namely, Tapan Kumar Roy @ Ray shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.25,000/-, with two sureties of like amount Tapan Kumar Roy @ Ray vs Unknown on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11096398/
1 each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
